homeIntro: Monitor live streams, manage your profiles, and keep recordings organized in one place.
profileIntro: Configure recording, storage and browser preferences for this profile.
deleteUploaded: Delete local files after successful upload
browserLoginInfo: Sign in to TikTok using the isolated browser session. Complete sign-in before importing cookies.
channelIntro: See stream status, start a manual recording or configure automatic capture.
videosIntro: Browse your recording library, play and download captured streams.
name: Name
noChannels: No channels yet. Open a profile to add your first channel.
trackedIntro: Live monitoring overview across all your profiles.
cloudIntro: Connect a cloud account to back up your recordings automatically.
exportIntro: Create an encrypted portable backup of application configuration and browser profiles.
exportInfo: The ZIP includes settings, encrypted cloud credentials and browser sessions. Videos and your stored passphrase file are excluded.
importIntro: Restore a previous application configuration backup.
importWarning: Import replaces all current configuration, accounts, profiles and browser sessions. Existing video files are preserved.
settingsIntro: Manage the application language and local encryption passphrase.
passphraseWarning: The passphrase is obfuscated on disk as requested, not protected by an operating-system key vault. Keep your data folder private and back up the passphrase securely.
confirmDelete: Delete this item? This action cannot be undone.
confirmImport: Replace all current configuration? Videos will be preserved. Continue?
checkingLive: Checking whether the channel is live...
vncReady: Browser login session reserved. Open the VNC browser.
playbackNote: Playback is transcoded with FFmpeg. It may use significant CPU and seeking can be limited.
